name: Face Stealer, Master (Su)
category: Rogue Genius Games – Slayer Advanced Talents
body:
Prerequisite(s): Slayer 14th level, advanced talents, minor face stealer talent, moderate face stealer talent, major face stealer talent

Benefit(s): The slayer’s face stealer ability talent can act as greater polymorph (self only) rather than disguise self.
